🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Your phone's GPS isn't just satellites... it's Einstein's Relativity in action! Without his mind-bending physics, your location would be wildly inaccurate.

Here's the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 GPS satellites orbit at incredible speeds, causing their clocks to tick slightly differently than ours on Earth.
🔹 Einstein's theories of Relativity explain this time difference, which needs constant correction.
🔹 Without these corrections, your GPS location would drift by about 6 miles (10 kilometers) *every single day*!
